reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — Math.random() at line 88 generates weak pseudo-random values used for rememberMeKey (line 89), which is stored in cookies and session attributes for authentication purposes. This is a known security anti-pattern. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — User-provided cookie value flows through param -> StringBuilder -> HashMap/Base64 -> split -> rememberMeKey -> response.getWriter().println() at lines 128-133 without proper HTML escaping. Both alerts represent genuine security issues.

evidence.note: Math.random() used to generate rememberMeKey for authentication cookie
